clues: Whoever went on to the library was either Rosa or Pearl.
The person headed to the inn got their item earlier than the person headed to the church.
Whoever went on to the bakery was handed something exactly 20 minutes after whoever went on to the inn.
Of the mail sack's recipient and the person handed something at 5:40 p.m., one was Hattie and the other was Kenji.
One of Jonah and Rosa was handed the spare key, and the other was handed something at 6:00 p.m.
Neither Pearl nor Rosa was handed the lantern.
Kenji got his item earlier than the person headed to the inn.
The 6:20 p.m. hand-off went to either Jonah or Kenji.
Either Hattie or Pearl was handed the pie tin.
Hattie got her item exactly 20 minutes after the person headed to the store got theirs.
hints: Look at the 6:20 p.m. column. Clue 8 offers two names; check each one against the other clues that mention them.
Use two clues together: clues 7 and 8 settle 6:20 p.m., and clue 5 follows. Then Suppose: the 6:20 p.m. person has only two places left to go.
Jonah went on to the bakery or the church. Suppose the bakery: clue 3 puts the inn at 6:00 p.m., and clue 2 leaves the church no later time.
With the church at 6:20 p.m., clue 3 keeps the inn before 6:00 p.m. So clue 7 keeps Kenji off 5:40 p.m., and clue 4 gives that slot to Hattie.

solution.key_idea: Clues 7, 8 and 5 hand Jonah the key at 6:20 p.m.; then supposing he went to the bakery leaves the church no later time.
steps: Clue 7 keeps Kenji off 6:20 p.m., so clue 8 puts Jonah there; clue 5 then gives Rosa 6:00 p.m. and Jonah the spare key.
By clues 6, 4 and 9, Rosa had the thermos and Pearl the pie tin. Hattie and Kenji had the lantern and the mail sack.
At 6:20 p.m., Jonah did not go on to the library (clue 1), the inn (clue 2) or the store (clue 10).
Suppose Jonah went on to the bakery. Then clue 3 puts the inn at 6:00 p.m., and clue 2 leaves the church no later time.
So Jonah went to the church. Clue 3 now keeps the inn before 6:00 p.m., so clue 7 keeps Kenji off 5:40 p.m.
So clue 4 puts Hattie at 5:40 p.m., and keeps the mail sack off that time: Hattie had the lantern, Kenji the mail sack.
Clue 10 puts the store at 5:20 p.m. The inn follows Kenji (clue 7), so it is Hattie's, at 5:40 p.m.; clue 3 puts the bakery, Rosa's, at 6:00 p.m.
Clue 1 sends Pearl to the library, which leaves Kenji the store. So Kenji came at 5:20 p.m., and Pearl at 5:00 p.m.
solution.epilogue: Teddy, hurrying to the green, handed Jonah the spare key at 6:20 p.m. Jonah tucked it in his coat and promised to drop it at the harbor office after his stop at the church.

answer_line: Jonah received the spare key at the ferry dock.
